doc_title: Quizzer · quiz games for the classroom
example_notice: This is an example app from Neblla: try it with your friends, nothing important is saved.
home_title: Quiz games in class, on the big screen and on phones
home_text: You write your questions, show them on the big screen, and everyone answers from their phone. Whoever gets the most right, and fastest, wins.
code_hint: The host of the quiz gives it to you. No account needed.
